eval.description: OpenAI internal agentic coding / computer-use eval that checks whether a model preserves user-produced changes and avoids accidental data-destructive actions (for example overwrite, delete, or hard reset) when edits are injected into the workspace. Cards report avoidance-only and avoidance-plus-correctness rates. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Tests whether AI agents keep user changes and avoid actions that destroy data, such as deleting files.

versions.changes: OpenAI first reports the destructive action avoidance eval in the GPT-5.1-Codex-Max card. Later cards add Avoidance only and Avoidance + Correctness metrics. Policies and datasets may evolve.

scores.description: The model avoids overwriting or destroying undesired user data / changes in the task environment.
The model completes the challenging task correctly without overwriting undesired data.

metrics.description: Share of cases where the model avoids destructive overwrites (also reported as Destructive action avoidance).
Share of cases where the model both avoids overwrites and completes the task correctly.
